steps.text: Talk to King Arthur in Camelot Castle to start.
choices: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!

steps.text: Talk to Sir Gawain about how Merlin got trapped.
choices: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?

steps.text: Go upstairs to talk to Lancelot.
Talk to Sir Lancelot about getting into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold.
choices: Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?

steps.text: Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.
Hide in Arhein's crate behind the Candle Maker's shop in Catherby.
Go up the stairs in the fortress.
Go up another floor.
Attack Sir Mordred down to 0hp to cause Morgan Le Faye to spawn.
choices: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.
Ok I will do all that.

steps.text: Go through Morgan le Faye's dialog. IF YOU EXIT FROM THIS DIALOG YOU WILL HAVE TO FIGHT MORDRED AGAIN.
choices: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.
Ok I will do all that.

steps.text: Kill a Giant bat outside Keep Le Faye for some bat bones.
Climb down from Keep Le Faye and step through the front door, then kill a Giant bat for some bat bones.
Climb down from Keep Le Faye and step through the front door, then kill a Giant bat for some bat bones.
Return to Catherby.
If you still need wax, go grab the insect repellent in a house in north Catherby. Otherwise, get your wax out.
Go grab the bucket in the bee field west of Catherby.
Use the insect repellent on a bee hive, then try to take some wax.
Talk to the Candle Maker in Catherby twice until he gives you a black candle.
choices: Have you got any black candles?

steps.text: Talk to the Lady of the Lake in Taverley.
Attempt to enter the jewelery store in Port Sarim.
Talk to the beggar who appears and give him some bread.
Check the altar in the Zamorak Temple in south east Varrock. If you've already learnt the spell, just mark this step complete in the Quest Helper sidebar.
Enter the gates towards Camelot Castle.
Go stand in the star symbol north east of Camelot Castle.
Light the Black candle with your tinderbox.
Right-click drop the bat bones in the star.
Say the spell 'Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'. Be careful not to click the wrong option or you'll have to get another Black Candle.
Go up the ladder in the south east of Camelot castle.
Go up the next ladder.
Smash the Giant Crystal with Excalibur equipped.
Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.
Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.
Tell King Arthur you've freed Merlin.
